quality_guards: First-aid provision depends on a workplace needs assessment rather than a universal staffing ratio.
Electrical inspection, test and isolation arrangements depend on equipment, environment and the actual circuit or task.
Construction emergency arrangements depend on the current site phase, layout, workforce, materials and escape strategy.
Building Safety Regulator reporting thresholds require phase- and occurrence-specific dutyholder assessment.
Emergency Alert receipt depends on device compatibility, software, settings and network conditions and does not reach every person.
Aviation occurrence reports are safety signals and do not by themselves establish blame, liability or final cause.
GMDSS carriage and equipment depend on vessel category, voyage and sea-area coverage.
DSC position transmission depends on correct integration with a position source.
Water interruption status and restoration timing are dynamic and require current company information.
Guaranteed-standard payment entitlement depends on customer type and qualifying conditions.
Priority-services support depends on recorded customer needs and incident arrangements and does not guarantee uninterrupted supply.
Official-source context is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
Live 130-candidate/16-endpoint parity, browser DOM/console acceptance and publisher remote readback remain required.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
